name: Introduction to Web Publishing
description: An introduction to publishing on the web: writing pages in HTML, styling them with CSS, and putting them online.
approach: Every class mixes a short talk with time to build. You learn by making a small site that grows all term.
outcomes: Style a page with CSS so it works on a phone and a laptop.
Publish a small site and keep it up to date.

textbook.required: None. Every reading is free and online.
access: Each week's readings are linked from the schedule.

requirements: You need a reliable internet connection and a free GitHub account.
